acceptance_oracle: When a user queues deterministic PREPARE work, the profile Activity history shows APPLICATION_QUEUED, APPLICATION_STARTED for each durable worker attempt, and APPLICATION_FAILED only at terminal dead-letter/retry-limit failure. Events survive API readback and reload, stay profile-scoped, use job/company context, and never expose resume content or imply a real application submission/confirmation.
gap_observation: Before the slice, the operation queue/worker already persisted mutable operation state and operation-scoped attempt audits, while the user audit read model had no profile-owned PREPARE lifecycle producers. Current acceptance invokes the real queue/claim/retry/failure transition path and observes the append-only profile audit history.
implementation: PREPARE queue audit is written in the same transaction as the durable operation upsert; stable IDs make repeated identical enqueue calls idempotent.
PREPARE started audit is written with the worker claim transaction and includes a distinct attempt number.
Terminal dead-letter failures from task execution and retry-limit lease recovery append one stable APPLICATION_FAILED event in the same transaction as the terminal operation state.
Only job ID, operation ID and attempt number are stored in these profile audit payloads; user-facing readback uses fixed summaries and safe job/company labels.
